# OpenXR SDK

Headers, import library and loader binary of the OpenXR SDK (https://github.com/KhronosGroup/OpenXR-SDK), release 1.1.61, built for Win32 x86.

- `include/openxr` - the OpenXR headers
- `lib/win32/openxr_loader.lib` - import library for the loader
- `bin/win32/openxr_loader.dll` - the loader, shipped in the game's Bin32 folder
